The 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set from Bullion Trading LLC offers a unique product to gun enthusiasts, collectors, and investors alike. Each set includes 10 exquisite bullets, each made from .999 pure silver and modeled after the .308 Winchester round, a popular and widely used cartridge in the United States.
This unique box set presents a fantastic investment option for those seeking to diversify their portfolio with distinctive silver products. Each bullet in the box has a diameter of 0.75 inches and a length of 2.71 inches, representing a substantial and impressive addition to any collection or investment.
In addition to the 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set, Bullion Trading LLC also provides individual 1 oz and 5 oz silver bullets. The 1 oz silver bullet features a design based on the .45 caliber round, while the 5 oz silver bullet takes inspiration from the 12 gauge shotgun shell. Each of these products is composed of .999 pure silver and is accompanied by a certificate of authenticity.
You can purchase the 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set, as well as the individual 1 oz and 5 oz versions, from Bullion Trading LLC by visiting the following links:
2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/silver/
1 oz silver bullet:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/1-oz-silver-bullet/
5 oz silver bullet:
https://bulliontradingllc.com/product/5-oz-silver-bullet/
For any queries or concerns about the 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set or the individual silver bullets offered by Bullion Trading LLC, you can reach their customer service team via email at
[email protected]
, or by calling 646-362-3536.
Invest in the unique and elegant 2 oz Silver Bullet Box Set from Bullion Trading LLC today and add a touch of distinction to your silver investment portfolio.
